text_block_list.text:
Today was the Fan Thanksgiving Festival.
The Umamusume took part in various events to entertain the fans.
Among them, Nakayama Festa—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Alright then, this is the team
we'll be running the 9,000m relay with.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yep! Let's do our best and aim for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooh!
The magnificent beauty of team sports!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what kind of combination is this-desu?!
This is a really unusual group of people for Nakayama-senpai to hang out with!
choice_data_list: I thought it would be a good opportunity for growth.

text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was scouring footage
of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, just like always—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, retirement!?
She just finally reached the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! Her competitive career was just getting started!"

text_block_list.name: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ""Any Umamusume who has journeyed with her sights set on this place, just as I have, would surely agree.""

text_block_list.name: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a place of longing and long-cherished dreams.
A fitting place for an end."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words,
someone who hasn't journeyed yet
doesn't know a damn thing, huh."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Let's be more proactive about gathering intel.

Nakayama Festa was probably
thinking the exact same thing back then.

With so little experience, it is difficult
for us to firsthand gain the kind of "experience"
that El Condor Pasa possesses.

"Then you're saying I must make up for it
by listening thoroughly to those with experience."
And so, we decided to deepen our bonds with the Umamusume who set their sights on France.
The Fan Appreciation Festival was the perfect opportunity to start mingling.
Of course, laying the groundwork to request entry into the same event was necessary. But the effort spent doing so was entirely trivial.

Once relay practice actually began,
we ran together and chatted during breaks.
Though short, we shared some truly rich and meaningful time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...And so...
...were you able to grasp it?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm glad.
Glad that you folks are kind enough to talk with us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even if I wasn't being nice,
you all still proactively came to talk to me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If anything, with communication that passionate,
I don't think anyone could turn them down!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for the compliment.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the 9,000m Relay begins!
—On your marks...!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pass the baton...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Aaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno...!
To think she could coordinate so smoothly with Cafe-senpai...!
choice_data_list: That's how hard Nakayama worked for it.

text_block_list.text:
Even if it meant taking on the unfitting role of a leader.
All to gain what they lacked.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“...... So all of this
is to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, yes?”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, charging up from the rear
is Gold Ship! Can Nakayama Festa
maintain the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of this '9000m Relay' is—
Team—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Second place, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I was hanging on right until the very end, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, for future races, you might want to pay
a bit more attention to your pacing!
Yeah, I'm sure you can nail it next time!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The pace, huh... Trainer,
did you film that last relay?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I see, then let's review that... and there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El, so you came to cheer me on too.
Well, how was my run?
Did you see the results of your guidance?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
! Pardon me.
Please give me a moment to think.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...? What's up with that guy?
The expression on El Condor Pasa's face as she ran off carried the sharp, thoughtful gaze of a hawk.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of this '9000m Relay' is—
Team—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, what an incredible 1st place!
Joining forces really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Yes.
I think I was able to set a good pace......

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*... *haah*...
I'd expect nothing less... from two powerhouses
who've won the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: To think you ain't even out of breath...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you are... aiming for France,
you must... find some leeway...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Room to spare?
choice_data_list: Do you mean aside from the pace as well?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... With both the races and the schedule...
pushing ourselves too far... won't last.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it comes!
Cafe-chan's special advice!
Nakayama-chan, you gotta take notes!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I get it, Laurel.
So Cafe, what are the details—...

Through the Thanksgiving Festival, Nakayama Festa had
developed a relationship where she could casually ask the two for advice.
choice_data_list: ......This too is proof of her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Being an interviewer really
just ain't my style, huh.
choice_data_list: Still, we got to hear a nice story, didn't we?
Still, we got to hear a nice story, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, well... there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El, so you came to cheer me on too.
Well, how was my run?
Did you see the results of your guidance?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
! Pardon me.
Please give me a moment to think.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...? What's up with that guy?
The expression on El Condor Pasa's face as she ran off carried the sharp, thoughtful gaze of a hawk.
